name: Muramite Citadel: Ascension
summary: A vertical gauntlet of fortified platforms and Discord-charged lifts leading toward the upper Citadel.
description: Ascension is the vertical passage connecting the Interior Citadel to its upper fortified layers. Muramite ascenders patrol Discord-charged platforms, while Inquisitors maintain arcane lifts that pulse with unstable energy. The climb is steep, dangerous, and heavily guarded. Dragorn infiltrators rarely survive the ascent, as the Muramite Legion treats this passage as a sacred proving ground for elite soldiers.
